5056095713269.sourceDescription:
Bring the warmth of Christmas into your home with our Pre-Lit Norway Spruce Christmas Tree. Full, natural-looking foliage and warm white LED lights create a welcoming centrepiece, ready for treasured ornaments and festive finishing touches. Available in heights, 6ft and 7ft.

This Norway Spruce has a beautifully full silhouette and a blend of realistic PE and PVC tips adding texture and depth, providing an abundant setting for your decorations.

The lights are already fitted, so you can enjoy bringing your Christmas decorating ideas to life. Choose a steady glow for cosy evenings, a gentle slow fade or a little twinkle for festive gatherings. There are 8 multifunction settings to explore, with mains power supplied through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, while the included folding metal stand provides a practical base. Gently separate the branches and arrange the tips to reveal the tree's full shape, then dress it with delicate neutrals, traditional reds and golds or colourful family favourites.

Features:
 Light functions: 8 settings, including steady glow, twinkle and slow fade
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

Take time to separate and shape the branches after assembly to achieve a full, balanced appearance.
Height: 7ft / 2.1m
Diameter: 152cm
Tip count: 2552 (1462 PE and 1090 PVC)
Lights: 500 warm white LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

5313817021669.variantName: 1 PCS Christmas Pillow Cover, 12x20 Inch, Green Soft Pellet Velvet, 3D Embroidered Xmas Tree, Xmas Pillowcase for Sofa Home Decor
5313817021669.sourceDescription:
Product Introduction
Create a warm and inviting Christmas home atmosphere with this festive lumbar cushion cover. The deep green background matches well with warm white pine tree motifs, combining soft tuft texture and delicate embroidery. The visible edge stitching enhances
 the handmade feeling. Made of breathable polyester fabric, the hidden envelope seam helps you change covers quickly. It is a lovely seasonal decor piece for your family’s Christmas. Pillow insert is not included.
Product Specifications

 Material: Soft polyester fabric
 Size: 30cm × 50cm
 Design: 4 Christmas trees, tuft & embroidery mix
 Closure: Envelope back
 Accessories: No pillow insert

Application Scenarios
Decorate your living room sofa, bay window, reading nook, dining bench, bedroom and armchair. Perfect for family Christmas celebration, winter home styling, holiday photo backdrop and gift for housewarming & Christmas.
Notes

 Separate washing is suggested to avoid color transfer.
 Do not tumble dry at high temperature.
 Store flat after holiday season to protect the tufted pattern.
 Keep out of reach of small children.
Exquisite Embroidery Craftsmanship: This Christmas pillow cover features 3D Christmas trees embroidery, creating a warm winter holiday scene. Compared with ordinary printed designs, the embroidered details are more textured, elegant, and fade-resistant, adding festive charm to your Christmas home decor.
Thick Fabric & Fine Sewing: Made of thick canvas (polyester) and pellet velvet, this Christmas throw pillow cover is soft, sturdy, and resistant to wrinkles or deformation. Tight stitching and neat seams without loose threads provide long-lasting durability for repeated holiday use.
Hidden Zipper & Tassel Accents: The matching invisible zipper creates a clean, elegant look and allows easy pillow insertion and removal. Perfect for both Christmas decor and winter home decoration.
Perfect Christmas Home Decoration: This decorative Christmas sofa pillow cover easily matches different home styles and holiday decorations. Perfect for sofas, couches, beds, reading nooks, bedrooms, and living rooms, it adds a warm and festive Christmas atmosphere and cozy winter touch to any space.
Easy to Maintain & Care: Machine wash or hand wash below 30°C with mild detergent and air dry naturally. Do not bleach or dry clean. The package includes 1 Christmas cushion cover only (12 x 20 inches / 30 x 50 cm); pillow insert is not included.

Coordinate colour and texture

5096042277369.baseName: Christmas wreath making supplies - Floristry decorations - 120 artificial pine and holly berry pieces for seasonal craft projects
5096042277369.variantName: Christmas wreath making supplies - Floristry decorations - 120 artificial pine and holly berry pieces for seasonal craft projects
5096042277369.sourceDescription:
Twenty artificial pine sprigs and 100 red holly berry pieces let you decide how dense to make your own arrangement. The 26 cm sprigs provide the outline, while the berries can be grouped into clusters for stronger points of colour.

Loose components give you control over where the colour and texture go. Divide the assortment across several small projects or concentrate it on one full wreath, choosing the spacing of each decorative group to suit the base.

Work out how many pieces to use for each project before you begin. Setting a portion aside for a second wreath or a table decoration makes it easier to carry the same colours across different parts of the room. Put loose pieces into small containers while you work to keep the details easy to find. A tray is particularly helpful for comparing a few possible groupings before choosing the one that goes on the wreath.

Lay out the different elements before fixing anything in place. Group them by size and colour, then try small clusters against your own base to see how the shapes look together at the distance from which they will be seen. To give a wrapped present a matching touch, set aside a few small elements before finishing the main arrangement. Using the same colours on the gift and the wreath helps a seasonal scheme feel considered.

A short run of repeated details brings a sense of rhythm to a garland. Space them first along the length, then move individual clusters closer together where you want a stronger patch of colour. Set the components on a plain cloth to compare their shapes and colours before committing to a layout.

When the project is finished, keep spare pieces together by type. They are then easy to find for a matching decoration, a last-minute place setting or a small change to the arrangement later in the season.
Includes 120 loose artificial pine sprigs and holly berry pieces for flexible seasonal craft projects.
Features 26 cm artificial pine sprigs to provide a structured outline for your wreath design.
Contains 100 red holly berry pieces that can be grouped into clusters for vibrant colour accents.
Loose components allow you to control spacing and density for customised floral arrangements.
Comes with 20 artificial pine sprigs and 100 red holly berry pieces

5096042276669.sourceDescription:
This 1.8 m garland uses red baubles about 3.5, 4.5 and 5.5 cm across. Their different sizes break up the outline along a mantel or door frame, and the plastic construction suits a decoration you handle when arranging it.

A garland lets you carry one theme across a length of the room. It can pick up the line of a shelf, a stair rail or a doorway, tying together different parts of a display without needing several separate decorations at each point.

Carry a colour from the garland into a small cluster of ornaments at either end. Repeating just one shade helps the whole display feel connected without adding so much decoration that the original details disappear. Viewed from across the room, a few gentle curves usually show the design more clearly than many tight bends. Lay the garland along its route before securing it and check how the ends fall from the main display.

Use your own ribbon at intervals to introduce a second colour without covering the main decorative detail. Measure the route you want the garland to follow, including the curves or dips along the way. A length laid straight across a mantel reaches further than the same length arranged in a series of deep swags.

On a staircase, plan the fixing points so the handrail stays easy to grip. Follow the line of the stairs from below as you arrange the length, checking that the lowest sections stay clear of the steps. For a dining table, try the garland along the centre before setting out plates. A shallow curve at either end keeps it within the table outline while leaving the middle available for a low seasonal display.

When you take the display down, release each fixing in turn and support the loose length as you go. Store it in broad curves, with enough space around the decorative details to avoid flattening them.
Red shatter-resistant baubles in three sizes for safe, festive display.
Versatile 1.8 m length ideal for mantels, staircases and doorways.
Lightweight plastic construction makes handling and arranging easy.
Creates a cohesive holiday theme across multiple room features.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 4x Chair Covers

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The multicoloured finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.
